title: Verify conversational human feedback and existing seed/priming receipts
description:
LATEST label checkpoint: Ryan supplied explicit yes/no and optional reasons in message Sentinel_bd250f6fa2e4819195e197b2b115d12a at 2026-10-20T03:54:30Z. RuneScape is yes for Anth.us (eventual post); MiniMax is no for Papyrus/TI/Anth.us; WhatsApp is yes for Pilobolus and no for Papyrus/TI/Anth.us. Unspecified choices remain undecided. Reasons and message provenance are preserved privately as received, not applied. This is curation authority, not publishing approval. Apply only through valid delegated-human authority to the correctly pinned output after baseline; never turn pending labels into pre-baseline seeds.

LATEST architecture correction (Ryan, 2026-10-20): BOTH modes must work and be tested from the start. First stage is ONE SHARED REMOTE Cyclotron with publication-relevance outputs for academic Papyrus, Threat Intelligence, Anth.us and Pilobolus. Evaluate the SAME discovered item/revision together across these outputs to share Jev work; independent models/calls/cyclotrons do not satisfy this requirement. Second stage is one INTEGRATED Cyclotron in each publication's Papyrus backend, with multiple classifiers, one per section. Integrated remains a supported deployment alternative generally, and is required here for the section layer. Neither mode is claimed working until verified end to end.

Verify the actual central lab/API endpoint separately from the cyclotron.anth.us marketing hostname, existing account and role-based capabilities, shared multi-output engine/binding, and integrated section bindings before any predictions or seeds. Preserve immutable source revision and shared decision identity, then scope prediction/label provenance to account, publication, output, binding revision and prediction fingerprint. Never silently fall back to local/independent first-stage models or seed/train the wrong backend. New persistent access/IAM or infrastructure requires exact approval; do not provision as an inferred quick-win requirement. No production merge/deploy authorization.

LATEST acceptance experiment order: first collect and persist the real Hacker News batch and present titles/URLs/provenance and publication context promptly; then capture Ryan's explicit yes/no and optional reasons; then run/evaluate the real current classifier baseline; only AFTER that baseline may verified already-human-accepted examples with his reasons be exercised through the existing seed mechanism, followed by a comparison. Preserve evaluation items separately from training/seeds where feasible. Capturing human evaluation answers is not permission to feed them into the baseline learner before the baseline. If existing delegated-human/priming behavior cannot maintain that separation, report the exact limitation rather than silently contaminate the comparison or forge tokens/labels. Preserve counts, snapshots/model versions, decision and feedback receipts and exact ordering; tiny samples may support process evidence only, not meaningful accuracy claims. No new UI prerequisite.

As a publication editor, I want to discuss real discoveries and existing accepted sources conversationally and have only my explicit authorized decisions relayed through existing human-feedback paths, so that we can verify the learning loop before building new UI.

Authorized quick-win checkpoint 3 follows checkpoint 1 real HN collection/persistence and checkpoint 2 real scoped predictions. Use current delegated-human labeling and seed/priming mechanisms, preserving the exact human message, publication, Reference lineage/revision, actor and delegation provenance. Ask publication-specific yes/no with optional why in chat/voice; faithfully relay explicit decisions without second guessing them. Do not fabricate a decision, actor, label, delegation token or receipt. If the existing path requires a missing token/identity, surface the exact blocked action/target/requirement rather than bypass it.

Inspect a few already accepted References for Anth.us, the academic Papyrus publication and Threat Intelligence only after resolving current bindings. Verify acceptance provenance; merely present, cited or machine-predicted material is not human accepted. Present candidates and original provenance to Ryan for optional explanation or confirmation; do not duplicate historical backfill, re-import or silently relabel them. Exercise the existing seed/priming mechanism only under its real authorization and deduplication rules.

Acceptance behavior:
```gherkin
Feature: Conversational human feedback and existing priming acceptance
  Scenario: Relay an explicit publication-specific human decision
    Given a real scoped discovery is available for publication-specific human evaluation
    And the existing delegated-human authority and required token are valid
    When Ryan explicitly answers yes or no for that publication with an optional explanation
    Then the exact decision and explanation are relayed through the existing supported mechanism
    And human message, actor, delegation, source revision and publication provenance are preserved
    And received, queued and applied feedback states and version receipts are verified separately
    And agent judgments do not substitute for his label
  Scenario: Missing delegation authority
    Given the required delegation token or identity is unavailable
    When conversational labeling is attempted
    Then the exact operation, target and missing requirement are reported
    And no label is fabricated or sent through an alternate authority path
  Scenario: Inspect previously accepted seed material
    Given a few current References have verified human acceptance provenance in the selected publication
    When they are presented for optional human explanation or confirmation and the existing seed mechanism is checked
    Then cited or merely present References are not treated as accepted labels
    And existing acceptance and priming receipts are inspected before any write
    And duplicate backfill or replayed seed labels are not created
  Scenario: Make learning claims from evidence
    Given intake, predictions and feedback receipts are available
    When progress is reported
    Then training or steering is claimed only with real applied feedback and version receipts
    And meaningful evaluation is reported where available
    And ingestion alone is not claimed to improve accuracy
```

Implement focused BDD, author/operator documentation and a small acceptance script for real candidates, explicit decision capture and receipt checks. Use existing UI or conversational paths, not a new review interface. No production merge/deployment, new IAM, mailbox, purchase or subscription authorization. Public source/classification work and this bounded existing-mechanism verification are authorized; human labels still require Ryan's actual explicit decisions and valid delegation.
